content: Mo꞉luwo꞉ ho꞉leno꞉ tambo Gode eyo꞉ nili ma꞉mu imo꞉ to sa꞉ma꞉nikiyo꞉, togo꞉ ko꞉li ko꞉lilo꞉ a꞉na iliki, dinali sa꞉lan kalu a꞉na a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ sa꞉la꞉len.

Ko꞉sega o꞉g ho꞉len elema꞉no꞉lo꞉ dowab wenamio꞉, Gode eyo꞉ ene So꞉waya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉yo꞉, towo꞉ nimo꞉wo꞉ a꞉na sa꞉la꞉li mio꞉. Gode eyo꞉ kelego꞉wo꞉ tambo ene so꞉wa wemo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉melea꞉ki da꞉fe alifa꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ henfelo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ akin o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ Gode eyo꞉ dimidakiyo꞉, ene So꞉waya꞉ dagiya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ dimido꞉.

Godeya꞉ ho꞉len malilo꞉ nafa a꞉no꞉ ene So꞉wa a꞉na a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ so꞉so꞉lelia꞉ga꞉ handalowa꞉sen ko꞉lo꞉lab. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ So꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Godeyo꞉ o꞉ngo꞉le a꞉lab. To halaido꞉ enedo꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ kelego꞉wo꞉ tambo halale alifo꞉lab. Ene mela꞉no꞉wo꞉ wala꞉takiyo꞉, kaluka꞉isaleya꞉ mogago꞉wo꞉ e hala꞉sa꞉ga꞉ malilo꞉ ta꞉ta꞉ga꞉yo꞉, e wabulun dowaki Gode Iwalulo꞉ A꞉lab a꞉ma꞉ dagi ililiba mesa꞉ni ane.
So꞉wa a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kaluwo꞉ mada tinio꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ wi emo꞉lo꞉ dimi a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kaluwa꞉ wiyo꞉ tinio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉lab.
To we Gode eyo꞉ ene So꞉wamo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Ge ni So꞉wa dowab.
O꞉go꞉ ne gi go꞉l dowo꞉l.”
“Ne ene iya doma꞉no꞉, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉
E ni So꞉wa doma꞉ib.”

content: Ko꞉sega Gode eyo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu imilig nowo꞉mbo꞉wo꞉ towo꞉ a꞉la꞉bo꞉ mo꞉sio꞉.
Gode eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa wa꞉la꞉b a꞉no꞉ henfelo꞉ wena tililia꞉ yakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Ma꞉mula꞉ kalu nilo꞉ gio꞉ tambo gulalu siliki, emo꞉ wabulu sama.”

content: Gode eyo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu ko꞉lo꞉ doma꞉no꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Niyo꞉ no꞉no꞉n ma꞉mula꞉ kalu i a꞉no꞉ fa꞉fa꞉s o꞉ngo꞉ ta꞉takiyo꞉,
No꞉no꞉n nanogdo꞉ dian kalu i a꞉no꞉ de wa꞉sowa o꞉ngo꞉ ta꞉felo꞉.”

content: Ko꞉sega Gode eyo꞉ ene So꞉wamo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Gode, ge misa꞉ dowo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, gilo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lab a꞉no꞉ ko꞉ngo꞉ mela꞉ib.
Man nafa digalo꞉ gilo꞉ a꞉na ilikiyo꞉, kaluka꞉isale go꞉no꞉ndo꞉ a꞉no꞉ a꞉ma꞉ bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉ib.
Ge man digalo꞉wo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asulaki, man mogago꞉wo꞉ mada mo꞉bea꞉sen.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ gi Gode niyo꞉ ge da꞉feaki, wa ho꞉n ko꞉lo꞉ tulu alifa꞉ a꞉na ilikiyo꞉,
ge sagalo꞉le dowaki, go꞉no꞉n miliyo꞉ tambo gi tininila꞉sa꞉ga꞉, iwalu ta꞉fo꞉.”

content: Gode eyo꞉ wa꞉ka ene So꞉wa o꞉mo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Alan, taminde amio꞉ henfelo꞉ we gi dimido꞉ ko꞉lo꞉,
Kelego꞉ akin amilo꞉ da꞉lab a꞉no꞉lo꞉ gi dagiya꞉ dimido꞉.
Akin o꞉lia꞉ henfelo꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ kelegema꞉ib ko꞉sega, ge ko꞉ngo꞉ mela꞉ib.
Kelego꞉ a꞉la꞉ a꞉no꞉ helebeso꞉g mo꞉luwo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ fefele ha꞉nakilo꞉ salibido꞉ o꞉ngo꞉ doma꞉ib.
Giyo꞉ henfelo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ akin o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ so꞉g ko꞉lo꞉ kambolan auma꞉ib.
Kelego꞉ a꞉la꞉ a꞉no꞉ helebeso꞉g ko꞉lo꞉ ko꞉li a꞉ta꞉tan aumbo꞉ o꞉li dimidama꞉ib.
Ko꞉sega ge dowo꞉ ko꞉ngo꞉ dofo꞉mela꞉ib.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ho꞉leno꞉ tambo ge mela꞉no꞉ mela꞉ib.”

content: Gode eyo꞉ ene So꞉wamo꞉wo꞉ towo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Niyo꞉ gis kalu gilo꞉wo꞉ gi ha꞉g amio꞉ semo꞉ difa꞉ a꞉namio꞉,
ge ni dagi ililiba siliki, ne o꞉lia꞉ bo꞉fo꞉lubi.”

content: Gode eyo꞉ to wengo꞉wo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu imilig nowo꞉mbo꞉wo꞉ mo꞉sio꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu iyo꞉ o꞉ba꞉le? Iyo꞉ mama ko꞉lo꞉, Godeya꞉ nanogdo꞉ dia꞉seno꞉ o꞉m. Gode eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale enedo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ gasilia꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asuwa꞉foma꞉ki iliga꞉ta꞉sen.
